registration.population: All successfully prepared frames from the 16-scene registration, excluding the 3 offered for Astra. No reference to evaluated collision outcomes. Include every frame even when no certificate exists.
registration.targets: All nonredundant baseline-menu certified controls. For each, shift 1.5 s and 3 s position box centers by respectively +0.20 and -0.20 m in the local lateral direction of the donor; retain original speeds and sizes. Independent recheck of the donor and the two new boxes required before comparing methods.
registration.methods: Cold fixed-corridor exact fit; a nearest other certified control/corridor with at most one exact fit (exclude generating candidate SHA). Also run the existing staged guided search with 5 control-fit budget and original stop-on-eligible for the first eligible target in each new frame. Compare exact and approximate separately.
registration.analysis: Count targets and scene/log clusters. Primary mechanism comparison exact paired leave-generating-control-out vs cold, paired two-sided sign randomization by log at alpha=.05; same precomputation made available, report its resources separately. Independent of model test. Fixed replication; no looking at results until completion.

registration.reason: Development 0797: all four fitted proposals meet other gates yet fail the unchanged predicted-clearance floor.
registration.search: Check free native candidate first, reuse eligible menu controls next, include seed supporting planes for the fixed object-clearance floor at 125 ms inside each new solve. Keep acceptance, times, budgets and fallback fixed.
sets: Same 12 witnessed window comparison frames, post hoc
All preregistered 26 historical real ADJUST responses with admissible causal inputs and bound native poses, development only
outcomes: new SLSQP calls excluding menu precomputation
3s paired ACR/CCR/ANY and L2 vs fast and original staged search, truth only after return selection
registration.adoption: Adopt only after comparing exact solving, acceptance and held-out reporting; no lowering floor or target tolerance.

registration.population: Every non-first witnessed target on the same 12 replication frames; the 12 first targets already used in staged development are excluded. One-fit outcomes previously seen. The full staged outcome on these remaining tasks has not been computed. Shared logs, not independent world validation.
arms: Original staged search including free native candidate
Free native first, same certified option menu leave-source-out, floor incorporated within the same maximum numerical fits

registration.gates: Identical. Stop on first accepted. Frozen recorded actor and mapped road labels absent from the search.

registration.scope: Development. All archived ADJUST targets, same frame and released weights. No target re-generation. Independently compare regenerated native poses with frozen poses at tolerance 0.5 mm and 0.0005 rad; failure or changed fast return reported. No extrapolation to test cohort. Fast default on KEEP/unresolved; retain frozen baseline routing. Compare all 26 targets, no selected outcome filtering.
Post hoc development, selected by causal initial-road-support failure prior to labels for this replay.
registration.method: Existing finite connected road patches from predicted boundaries in native, navigation and straight axes. Require both independent heads, positive area connectivity, no measured boundary in initial body, joint initial body support. Report separately because the road support geometry changes. All other controls, clears and candidates checked as before; inherit floor-aware return elsewhere.

registration.scope: Post hoc after observed solve/aggregate collision and L2 tradeoff. All 25 bound archived requests. Historical development; never confirmatory.
registration.search: After its first eligible proposal, allow one additional hard-node solve from that proposal in the same fitted rectangles. Minimize deviation from the admitted fast center positions, regularized acceleration/steer changes. No ground truth. Only select if closer to fast, exact at both targets, original independent conditions and floor met; neither predicted map head may lose clearance below min(previous,0.30 m). Otherwise retain previous. Extra solve reported separately.
registration.outcomes: Paired ACR/CCR/ANY, L2, exact and approximate coverage, fits; same aggregate GT metrics in evaluation process. No reruns with tuned weights.

registration.selection: All 59 historical paired published-positive frames with NO archived slow dispatch. Outcomes known in aggregate. No model generation.

gates.review: legacy trigger or either available predicted map head has a swept-body clearance lower bound <= 0.30 m on the delivered fast track (existing code uses its registered comparator).
gates.extra: If not already reviewing, both heads must have numeric minimum body clearance <= 0.925 m and fall from initial by >=0.30 m in each head. No other thresholds or optimization.

registration.comparison: Verify regenerated native poses within 0.0005 m/rad of historical native in all seven poses, and fast returned BODY poses against archived selected xy. Independently score or bind scored return. Count missing, re-routed original collisions, added noncollision reviews. No claims of prevention.
